content.normative_statement: A Definition Pack is an identifiable, version-exact semantic bundle for one bounded goal, originating intent, declared context, named consumer and intended use. It records the required concept set and exactly one current handling disposition for each concept: reuse, specialize, propose or open. Each disposition has its matching payload. The Pack freezes selected sources and evidence with their standing at capture, owner routes or explicit ownership gaps, scoped relationship records, unresolved obligations, validation scope and the limits of its claim. Reused meanings retain their exact authority. A specialization explicitly distinguishes an application within an existing meaning from a proposed new or revised normative meaning. Pack existence, well-formedness and readiness for a named use do not themselves admit a Definition or permit execution.
content.formal_expression: P=(id,revision,g,i,k,u,C,delta,H,E,O,R,Q,V,A); D={reuse,specialize,propose,open}; WellFormed(P) iff ExactIdentity(id,revision) and BoundedGoalContextUse(g,k,u) and TraceableIntent(g,i) and FiniteNonempty(C) and (delta in Functions(C,D)) and (dom(H)=C) and (forall c in C: PayloadMatches(H(c),delta(c))) and (forall r in References(P): (ResolvedWithStandingAtCapture(r) or DeclaredGap(r,Q))) and ValidationScopeDeclared(V) and NoNewAuthorityFromPack(A). WellFormed(P) does not entail ReadyFor(P,u,current_inputs), Admitted(Candidates(P)), or MayExecute(u).

notation.meaning: The frozen bundle; id/revision identify its exact selected material and declared lineage.
Bounded goal, attributable intent, explicit context, named consumer with one declared intended use.
Finite nonempty set of distinct required concept identities. Duplicate rows must be rejected before constructing it.
Exactly reuse, specialize, propose and open.
One total single-valued current handling choice for every required concept.
Matching payload function with domain C; specialization declares application-parameters or proposed-semantic-change.
Captured source/evidence standing, owner routes or ownership gaps, scoped relationships and unresolved obligations.
Declared validation profile, subject/input bindings, criteria/outcome scope and evidence ceiling.
No new semantic admission or action permission is created by the Pack; separately admitted source meanings keep their authority.
Exact resolved reference and declared posture in the frozen source epoch. This does not assert currentness for every later use.
Use-specific gate evaluated separately against current inputs and applicable obligations. Reviewable does not mean executable.
Proposed Definition outputs, possibly none; their exact owner decisions remain separate.

boundary_conditions: The required concept set is declared and bounded; complete handling does not prove exhaustive discovery of every relevant concept.
An unresolved outcome has an explicit question, reason, affected use, owner route or ownership gap and continuation; it is never an invented answer.
Reuse binds one exact current admitted meaning at capture and its applicability; a later change in source standing requires separate current-use assessment.
Specialization within the parent meaning produces an application binding. A new or changed normative meaning produces a complete proposed Definition through the explicit identity/successor route.
One Pack can yield zero, one or many Definition candidates; it does not own their normative meanings.
Role/owner routing labels and producer attribution do not establish Role Assignments or action permission.
A source resolving is distinct from its admission, currentness, truth and permitted use.
Relationship suggestions are scoped records; they do not create global Typed Relations.

A changed selected input, intended use, payload, concept set or meaning produces a new frozen revision with lineage; current-use assessments may be separate records and do not rewrite the frozen Pack.
Validation scope is required even when all selected references resolve.
Independent review, consumer-use, semantic-owner, capability-adoption and execution decisions retain their own scopes.
No semantic admission or new action permission is inferred from this bundle or any structural PASS.
testable_conditions: Missing, duplicate or undeclared concept dispositions fail well-formedness.
Every disposition payload matches its exact tag; specialization declares whether normative meaning changes.
A resolved candidate source cannot be labeled admitted reuse merely because its reference resolves.
An unresolved source or owner has a visible scoped gap.
All references resolving with validation scope absent still fails well-formedness.
A frozen valid record can remain reviewable when its source standing has changed; a new consequential use still requires current-source/owner assessment.
Partial selection cannot resolve or authorize unselected concepts.
A Pack with a proposed meaning does not imply an admitted Definition or an authorized agent action.

content.explanation: For one task, the Pack records which concepts the work needs, what can be reused, what is being narrowed or proposed, and what remains unanswered. It keeps the exact sources, context, ownership questions and limits visible so the next person or agent can review the meaning without guessing. A saved Pack preserves what was known then; using it later requires checking what has changed.

For an agent investigating the Northstar export incident, the Pack can reuse the admitted Incident meaning, specialize Work as a bounded investigation application, propose identifier completeness for a fixed account/filter/snapshot/output, and keep account exclusivity open. The frozen bundle describes the semantic work and its questions. It is not production telemetry, an incident finding, a closure decision or permission to repair data.
examples: INC-1042 proposes identifier completeness for Northstar, status=active, saved snapshot S-1042 and output E-1042.
The same Pack may be reviewed while the criterion for account exclusivity remains unanswered.
Applying Work to the incident changes application parameters without redefining Work.
A later source/meaning update requires current-use assessment; it does not rewrite the earlier captured record.

content.normative_statement: CyberAlchemy Define is the Lab capability to make the meaning required for one bounded Goal and its originating Intent explicit for a named consumer and intended use. It examines selected existing meanings and their source standing, identifies the declared required concepts, exposes ambiguous or missing meaning and ownership gaps, and prepares a reviewable Definition Pack with exactly one current disposition—reuse, specialize, propose or open—for each declared required concept. The result preserves the originating Intent, explicit Goal and concept-set revisions, exact source bindings and unresolved obligations. It establishes coverage of the declared concept set, not exhaustive discovery of every relevant concept. A recorded open question may be part of a conforming result; an interrupted or failed attempt does not by itself produce one. Define does not select the consumer solution, appoint an owner, admit a Definition, achieve the Goal or grant execution authority. Its Product Capability instance separately binds exactly one Product, scope, owner and outcome contract; a Method specifies the governed transformation, and CLI or agent-based implementations may realize the capability.
content.formal_expression:
X=(g,i,k,u,E,C0); D={reuse,specialize,propose,open};
ConformingDefineResult(X,P) iff WellFormedPack(P)
  and PreservesIntentAndGoalLineage(X,P)
  and AccountsForDeclaredConcepts(C0,C(P),P)
  and (delta_P in Functions(C(P),D))
  and RecordsSourceStandingAndGaps(X,P)
  and ReviewableFor(P,u) and NoNewAuthorityFromPreparation(P).
ConformingDefineResult(X,P) does not entail ExhaustiveDiscovery(X),
  ReadyForConsumerAction(P,u), Admitted(Candidates(P)),
  GoalAchieved(g), or MayExecute(u).

notation.meaning: Selected input: Goal (with its Project link), originating Intent, context, named consumer plus intended use, exact selected sources/evidence and initial required concept set.
Resulting Definition Pack, its declared required concept set, its single-valued total disposition function and the four closed handling tags.
The Pack contract proposed in step 1, exact candidate.3. This remains a coupled candidate dependency until its applicable admission.
Attributable Intent and Goal are retained; explicit refinements or replacements keep their reasons and prior lineage. No silent satisfaction or lifecycle transition.
All initially required concepts remain handled or have explicit scoped revision evidence. Newly required concepts enter the resulting set; omissions cannot be silently relabeled as completeness.
Exact selected source standing at capture, ownership routes or gaps, unanswered questions, and affected next uses remain visible; capture is not a perpetual-currentness guarantee.
Consumer, use, boundaries, exact references and unresolved obligations are inspectable. This does not mean that the consumer approved the Pack or may act on it.
Preparing a Pack grants no new semantic admission or action permission; existing admitted meanings retain their separately scoped authority.

boundary_conditions: Capability meaning, owner-qualified Product Capability instance, governed Method, Implementation, Agent and Definition Pack remain separately identifiable; each answers a different declared question.
One Goal retains its Project and owner routes. A Define result is not evidence that all Goal success conditions are satisfied or that its owner recorded achievement.
Intent, Goal and required-concept changes are explicit and attributable. A consumer solution or convenient output shape cannot silently replace them.
Coverage is relative to the declared required set and selected sources. Undiscovered requirements and unselected repository content are not claimed covered.
An open disposition can be reviewed while blocking a named next use. Unanswered questions and unavailable owners are not fabricated resolutions.
Specialization distinguishes application parameters under an existing meaning from a proposed normative change. Proposed changes require their own applicable review and admission.
Source standing is recorded at capture. A later consequential use requires its own relevant source, owner and contract currentness checks.
A structurally invalid output, provider failure or interrupted attempt is not a conforming result. No particular CLI exit code or future protocol schema is defined by this capability meaning.
The Product Capability owner, Definition semantic owner and incident investigation owner are separate roles. Naming a route or possessing local signing keys does not appoint any of them.

Machine Agent Instances cannot outlive or span Sessions. Long-term context comes from governed Project State through Context and Ontology Views; Session Memory remains session-bound. Saved Define work records become Project State only through the applicable governance route.
testable_conditions: The result retains the selected Intent/Goal or records an attributable revision and rationale instead of silently dropping the original requirement.
Each distinct required concept has one matching disposition payload; duplicate, missing or undeclared rows fail the selected Pack contract.
An unanswered exclusivity criterion remains open and names the next use it blocks; it is not reported as accepted or resolved.
A tool failure without a conforming Pack remains an unsuccessful attempt even when a process exits or an agent reports completion.
Reusing an admitted Definition preserves its exact version and captured standing; a generated proposal remains candidate.
CLI and agent-based realizations can satisfy the same outcome contract without sharing implementation identity or gaining authority from that equivalence.
Producing the Pack does not change the incident, admit a candidate, mark its Goal achieved or permit a production repair.

content.explanation: Define helps a person or agent establish what the next task depends on: which meanings already apply, what needs a proposal, and which questions remain unanswered. It leaves that work in a reviewable Definition Pack. The Pack covers the concepts explicitly selected for the task; it does not claim to know everything or approve the next action.

For the Lab integration, Define is the enabled outcome; its owner-qualified Product Capability instance, preparation Method and exact realization binding are separate pending work. The existing CLI candidate reads selected Project State, Context Views and Ontology Views, but its legacy output is not yet the M1 Lab preparation preview. The incident illustration explains the desired outcome without claiming a live agent run or an admitted incident assessment.
examples: For INC-1042, Define clarifies the meanings needed to investigate saved Northstar export evidence with status=active, snapshot S-1042 and output E-1042. The Goal is linked to one illustrative investigation Project; no Project or Goal record is created by the illustration.

The Pack reuses Incident, applies Work through explicit investigation parameters, proposes identifier completeness and leaves account exclusivity open. Required-ID coverage and exclusion of unrelated records remain separate questions.

The illustrative 12,000 required IDs and 11,800 matched required IDs show the proposed completeness criterion would fail by 200 IDs; this is a conditional fixture interpretation, not a production finding or Define execution.
A CLI workflow or ephemeral machine-agent Session can realize Define. A saved Pack supports later review; it is not private long-term machine-agent memory, owner acceptance or a production repair.

content.normative_statement: A Definition is a versioned, owner-scoped semantic artifact that assigns a term one normative meaning within an exact authority scope. It is structurally complete only when stable identity, applicability, exclusions, a scientific/formal normative voice, explicitly non-normative plain-language and domain-context voices, boundaries, admitted source posture, primary consumers, a synchronized registry postimage, generated index, and a current drift route are declared. Only an exact owner promotion decision can make one exact Definition version canonical authority.
content.formal_expression: DefinitionComplete(d) iff StableId(d) and ExactScope(d) and FormalVoice(d) and NonNormativePlainVoice(d) and NonNormativeDomainVoice(d) and Boundaries(d) and AdmittedSources(d) and RegistryPostimage(d) and GeneratedIndex(d) and CurrentDriftRoute(d). DefinitionComplete(d) does not imply Admitted(d).

notation.meaning: One stable Definition identity at one exact version, evaluated together with its declared review package.
Identity and exact version; authority scope, applicability and exclusions. A filename or classification label cannot supply these silently.
One normative statement with applicable formal expression, notation, boundary conditions and testable conditions.
Explicitly explanatory voices that retain the same scope and meaning; they cannot independently extend the normative statement.
Declared meaning limits and exact source standing admitted for the applicable target use. Authored candidates can expose unresolved source gaps, but those gaps block promotion readiness.
Declared proposed registry and reproducible lookup projection for the exact version. Completeness requires resolved package material, not merely a placeholder reference.
Accountable owner, audit and challenge route applicable to the selected scope and current review inputs.
Structural/governance completeness of the declared package and separately selected owner admission. Neither a schema pass nor an evaluated example selects admission.

boundary_conditions: A changed normative meaning requires a new Definition version.
Interpretive voices cannot weaken or expand the normative voice.
Schema validity and evidence do not perform promotion.
The successor preserves the admitted normative statement and formal expression. Its applicable-carrier verification rule replaces the v1-only rule; historical bindings remain explicit.

Carrier, schema, generator and applicable evaluation/lifecycle profile references require exact version, digest, standing and compatibility dispositions. A caller cannot select an arbitrary schema to bypass the applicable contract.
A shape-valid authored record may have unresolved admission obligations. It is not thereby DefinitionComplete or admission-ready.
Checking a criterion against example data is distinct from checking the Definition artifact and its semantic fidelity.
No predecessor connection is silently retyped, copied into a new global relation, removed from history or deemed compatible solely by schema acceptance.
testable_conditions: The exact machine record validates against its exact applicable Definition carrier and bound evaluation profile under an explicit version/compatibility disposition; schema, generator and profile standing are resolved for the proposed use.
The generated projection is byte-identical across two renders and matches the exact bound generator output.
The candidate appears exactly once in the proposed registry and generated index; live current lookup remains unchanged before the applicable admission/application.
The three voices preserve one normative meaning and its scope; source, owner and drift routes resolve under their separate standing requirements.
Each predecessor semantic, carrier and embedded connection binding receives an explicit preservation, compatibility, update or blocking disposition.
Formal distinction/consistency evidence declares its interpretation, scope and limitations; it does not imply unrestricted consistency or replace owner semantic fidelity review.
Pre-decision eligibility is assessed separately from the final exact owner decision, so an otherwise eligible candidate need not already be admitted.

content.explanation: A Definition is the owner-scoped record that states what one term means, where that meaning applies and where it stops. Its formal statement governs; the plain-language and domain-context voices explain the same meaning. Its exact representation, sources, consumers and review route are declared. Checks supply evidence, and only the applicable owner decision makes the exact version authoritative.

The Lab stores Definition JSON as the canonical machine record and generates Markdown from it. This successor keeps the admitted foundational meaning and stable identity while replacing the v1-only verification rule with an exact applicable carrier/profile binding. The admitted Definition/v2 carrier already exists; compatible v2 evaluation and lifecycle successors and consumer dispositions remain pending. The incident example uses an actual repository candidate with illustrative data, without claiming an accepted production finding.
examples: The export identifier completeness candidate states a criterion for fixed snapshot S, account A, filters F and saved output E. Its three voices explain inclusion of required IDs; accuracy and account exclusivity remain separate.
A required population of 12,000 IDs and 11,800 matched IDs would fail the proposed coverage criterion. This does not invalidate the Definition record structure or admit its meaning.
An agent can read a generated human view, but authoritative meaning comes from the exact owner-admitted machine record and scoped bindings; neither an ontology label nor the agent output replaces it.
If this successor is later admitted, the predecessor retains its exact bytes and admission history. Existing consumers do not silently rebind to the successor.

content.normative_statement: A Definition Evaluation Profile is a reusable, owner-qualified, version-exact contract declaring how an Evaluation assesses one exact Definition version and its declared review package within a named scope and phase. It binds the subject and input selection, applicable governing contracts, required checks, evidence requirements, permitted outcomes, causal blockers, phase-specific aggregation, pre-decision eligibility and claim limits. It specifies the rules for producing and interpreting evaluation evidence; a declared profile does not establish that an Evaluation occurred, that its criteria passed, that an owner selected admission or that an effect was applied.

notation.meaning: Exact profile identity/revision and selected Definition subject representation.
Exact subject/input selection, one Definition version, input state, authority/applicability scope and named phase.
Finite declared check identities, outcome vocabulary, one complete evaluation result map and causal blocker contract.
Declared phases, required aggregation subset for one phase, and its outcome rule. Completeness of check reporting and phase aggregation are different obligations.
Qualified profile owner and explicit coverage/authority claim limits.
Interpretation of a conforming completed evidence record, not a guarantee that every attempt succeeds. Relevant subject/profile/input versions and scope must match.

boundary_conditions: The semantic meaning is independent of its carrier revision. Exact v1 bootstrap mechanics and later v2 adoption are separately declared representation/review choices.
The declared scope is Lab Definition governance. It does not supply a general profile for unrelated artifact kinds.
A changed subject, profile, selected source or evidence epoch invalidates affected evidence; prior material is preserved without automatic refreshing.
Schema/projection PASS, semantic interpretation fidelity, applicable owner selection and confirmed application remain separate obligations.
Every declared check receives a scoped result or an explicit not-evaluable blocker; only the named phase subset contributes to its aggregate.
A required check with missing applicable evidence is NOT_EVALUABLE; an established violation is FAIL. Missing evidence is not a proof of violation.
Admission-selection/application checks can be reported as pending while excluded from pre-decision aggregation.
testable_conditions: The semantic record preserves exact identity, scope, three voices and selected carrier/generator bindings.
Profile declarations, completed evidence, owner selection and confirmed effects have separate identifiers and evidence.
The incident example retains the account, filters, source snapshot and saved output boundaries.
No missing review or unperformed effect is reported as completed.

content.explanation: The contract for checking a Definition and understanding the results. It says which evidence is required, which checks contribute to each phase and why other checks are blocked. The results describe only what was actually established; they do not approve the Definition.

This revised semantic binding applies to the proposed v2 profile/carrier. The candidate itself uses admitted Definition/v1 mechanics and current v1 review routes as the explicit bootstrap choice, independent of the meaning’s scope. No v2 self-approval or owner acceptance is claimed.
examples: For the identifier-completeness Definition, schema and projection checks pass while required semantic evidence remains NOT_EVALUABLE.
The incident’s 200 missing IDs make its proposed coverage predicate false. That is a different subject from whether the Definition record meets its governance contract.

content.normative_statement: A Definition Lifecycle Profile is a reusable, owner-qualified, version-exact contract declaring the initial posture, permitted states and directed transitions for one exact Definition version under selected governing contracts. It binds each transition to its required evaluation and review evidence, applicable owner authority, intended effect, invalidation conditions and history-preservation rules. It separates satisfied gates, recorded review, selected admission and confirmed application. Declaring the profile or satisfying a gate does not itself record a new state, select an owner Decision, apply an effect or prove that a transition occurred.
content.formal_expression:
P=(id,v,T,Q,q0,E,Gate,Effect,o,s,Invalidate,History); E subseteq Q x Q.
PermittedBy(P,d,a,b,I) iff ExactBinding(P,d,I) and (a,b) in E and Gate(P,d,a,b,I)=PASS.
PermittedBy(P,d,a,b,I) does not entail TransitionRecorded(d,a,b) or EffectApplied(d,Effect(P,a,b)).
ConsistentAdmittedState(d) requires applicable exact owner admission selection and confirmed application; declaration alone provides neither.

notation.meaning: Exact profile identity/revision, selected Definition representation and one exact Definition version.
Declared states, initial posture and finite directed transition pairs; no transition is inferred from independent state lists.
Scoped requirements and exact evidence/authority input state. PASS establishes the gate; unknown or unsupported evidence does not establish permission.
Declared effect, qualified authority owner and applicability scope. Effect selection and confirmed application remain separate facts.
Rules for changed epochs, affected evidence invalidation and immutable historical state/receipt preservation.
Conditions allowing a transition, a separately attributable transition record and separately confirmed effect; none is silently substituted for another.

boundary_conditions: The semantic meaning is independent of its carrier revision. Exact v1 bootstrap mechanics and later v2 adoption are separately declared representation/review choices.
The declared scope is Lab Definition governance. It does not supply a general profile for unrelated artifact kinds.
A changed subject, profile, selected source or evidence epoch invalidates affected evidence; prior material is preserved without automatic refreshing.
Schema/projection PASS, semantic interpretation fidelity, applicable owner selection and confirmed application remain separate obligations.
A permitted directed pair and satisfied gate do not move the subject automatically; each actual transition requires an attributable record and applicable confirmed effect.
Initial posture is a contract declaration, not evidence of another record’s actual state.
Pre-decision readiness is an assessment, not an extra lifecycle state. Defer/revise/reject outcomes do not silently create a withdrawal effect.
testable_conditions: The semantic record preserves exact identity, scope, three voices and selected carrier/generator bindings.
Profile declarations, completed evidence, owner selection and confirmed effects have separate identifiers and evidence.
The incident example retains the account, filters, source snapshot and saved output boundaries.
No missing review or unperformed effect is reported as completed.

content.explanation: The contract for when a Definition may change state, what evidence and authority are needed, and what history must be kept. A passed check can satisfy a condition; an actual state change still needs its declared record and applicable effect.

This revised semantic binding applies to the proposed v2 profile/carrier. The candidate itself uses admitted Definition/v1 mechanics and current v1 review routes as the explicit bootstrap choice, independent of the meaning’s scope. No v2 self-approval or owner acceptance is claimed.
examples: The completeness Definition stays candidate-authored while semantic review and admission remain pending.
Even an eligible owner-reviewed Definition stays unadmitted when the admission Decision or its confirmed application is missing.

new_material_acceptance: No prior acceptance is relabeled as approval of this fresh formal interpretation or final cohort.
